The applicant has filed the present application under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. for seeking modification of order dated 15.05.2024 passed in M.Cr.C No.42949/2021.
2.

It is the case of the applicant that the applicant is facing trial in the Court of CJM, Satna for offences punishable under Sections 7(1)/16,7(i1i)/16 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act 1954 (for short 'the Act of 1954').

During pendency of the trial an application for trying the case summarily and for passing a sentence of fine in the light of judgment passed by the Hon'ble Supreme court in the case of Nemichand v. State of Rajasthan Criminal Appeal No.215/2016 dated 10/03/2016 was filed.

entities.text: Nemichand v. State of Rajasthan Criminal Appeal No.215/2016
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The same was rejected by the learned trial Court which was challenged by filing M.Cr.C. No.42949/2021.

The said M.Cr.C. was disposed off vide order dated 15.05.2024 directing the trial Court to re-consider the application filed under Section 16-A of the Act of 1954 in light of observations made by the NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:24593 2 MCRC-20075-2025 Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Nemichand Jain (supra).

3. It is agued that the trial Court took cognizance of the order passed by the Hon'ble High Court on 11.06.2024 and on 27.07.2024 the learned JMFC placed the matter before CJM Satna for further consideration of the application as it has no jurisdiction to try the case summarily.
The CJM Satna despite several dates have not considered and took a final decision in light of judgment passed by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Nemichand Jain (supra).
Therefore, this application is filed seeking modification of the order passed by this Court on 15.05.2021.

It is argued that the M/S Nirma Ltd. vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/5636812/
1 learned CJM is pointing out that there was no direction by the Hon'ble High Court for imposition of cost during the summary proceedings and disposal of the matter.

entities.text: M/S Nirma Ltd. vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Therefore, the Court is at liberty to proceed the matter in accordance with law.
4. However the fact remains that the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Nemichand Jain (supra)
while considering Section 16-A of the Act of 1954 regarding compounding of offence has partly allowed and sentence was modified by imposing cost of Rs.50,000/- to be deposited within two months
. Under these circumstances, the learned CJM should have considered the matter and dispose off the application of the applicant during summary proceedings as the applicant has accepted the guilt.
Therefore, the provisions of Section 16-A of the Act of 1954 was fairly attracted.

Under these circumstances, the order passed in M.Cr.C. No.42949/2021 is modified to the extent that the trial Court should consider for compounding of offence in terms of Section 16-A of the Act of 1954 and dispose off the matter by NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:24593 3 MCRC-20075-2025 imposing punishment of fine to be deposited by the petitioner within a particular time frame.

5. The learned trial Court to consider the aspect that the aforesaid provisions have been inserted by the legislature taking note of various aspects including the fact that the applicant may be first offender in the matter.
Therefore, imposition of fine as a matter of penalty can be the appropriate punishment to be imposed.

6. Under these circumstances, the order dated 15.05.2024 passed in M.Cr.C. No.42949/2021 is modified to the extend that the trial Court is directed to consider and decide the application taking note of Section 16-A of the Act of 1954 and by imposing fine to be deposited in stipulated time frame as expeditiously as possible.
7. With these observations the application is disposed off.
8. This order be read conjointly with the order dated 15.05.2024 passed in M.Cr.C. No.42949/2021.
(VISHAL MISHRA) JUDGE L.Raj M/S Nirma Ltd. vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/5636812/
